Subject: Network isolation & compliance follow-up from today

Hi Luke —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can get your security/compliance team everything they need: 

Recap from discovery:
- You run regulated workloads (HIPAA posture) and need network isolation with optional air-gapped deployment for certain devices.
- Priority items: SOC 2 report, GDPR/HIPAA controls mapping, vendor security questionnaire, and a sample private/VPC deployment diagram.
- Preferred timeline: initial evidence & questionnaire by end of next week, deeper architecture session the week after.

What I can provide this week:
1) Redwood security profile (SOC 2 scope, ISO/GDPR/HIPAA notes, control owners) — I will attach a redacted SOC 2 summary.
2) A small-network sketch showing VPC-only deployment + on-prem connector and an air-gapped option.
3) The vendor security questionnaire (we can pre-fill common answers to speed your intake).

Proposed next steps (can adjust based on your intake process):
- You confirm the intake path (SaaS vendor portal vs email) and the required recipients for the questionnaire.
- I upload the redacted SOC 2 summary and deployment sketch to a secure Drive link and send over the XLS questionnaire (this week).
- Schedule a 60-min technical sync with our infra engineer (Karthik) to walk the architecture and air-gap tradeoffs (preferably Nov 10–12).

If that matches, I will attach the files and send the questionnaire to Annette and your security tooling inbox.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

2) Air-gapped option: our regulatory group wants to understand whether the "air-gapped" deployment is fully offline (manual updates) or a short-window sync model. Could you include pros/cons and operational considerations?

Timeline: getting the first set by Nov 6 works. We will review and come back with any clarifying questions.

Hi Luke / Annette —

Thanks for confirming the intake path. Per our internal tasks, attaching the initial package for your intake team and a short mutual action plan (MLP):

Attachments (in this email):
- redwood-security-profile-v2.pdf — redacted SOC 2 Type II summary (June 2026) + controls mapping to HIPAA/GDPR.
- initial-deployment-sketch.png — three small diagrams (VPC, VPC+on-prem connector, air-gapped).
- vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx — pre-filled answers to common items; we left open items for your legal/security to confirm.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) Nov 6–9: MedTech reviews artifacts & returns any clarifying Qs (security@medtech.co).
2) Nov 10–12: Technical sync (60 min) with Karthik to review architecture and air-gap operational model. I propose Nov 11 at 10:00 AM PT — can you confirm?
3) Nov 15: Decision checkpoint — go/no-go for POC or deeper security assessment.

Short note on the air-gapped option (summary):
- Fully air-gapped: no network egress from host nodes; updates via signed artifact exchange and manual deployment. Pros: maximal network isolation; Cons: operational overhead, delayed patching, limited remote debugging.
- Short-window sync: scheduled outbound-only sync windows over an approved channel for updates/telemetry. Pros: easier maintenance; Cons: requires strict controls on transport and scheduling.

If this aligns, I'll upload the Drive folder and send a secure link to security@medtech.co as well as share the pre-filled questionnaire.

Best —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-security-profile-v2.pdf, initial-deployment-sketch.png, vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx
